summary.text: Ned Carroll is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for District 42A, in office since January 2023, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026, against Republican Kathy Burkett. He is an attorney.

paragraphs.text: Ned Carroll lives in Plymouth, Minnesota.

He earned a B.S.S. in economics and political science from Cornell College, an M.A. in public policy analysis from Rutgers University, and a J.D. from the University of Iowa, and works as an attorney.
Carroll defeated Kathy Burkett in the November 8, 2022, general election for District 42A and defeated her again on November 5, 2024.
He serves on the House Capital Investment Committee.
